title: Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung (SAZV), § 12 Rufbereitschaft, in der vor dem 1. Januar 2025 geltenden Fassung (a.F.), as transcribed by buzer.de
in_force: no: the version in force until 31 December 2024, before Art. 5 No. 4 of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78, which took effect retroactively from 1 January 2025 (Art. 7(2), bgbl-2025-i-78.txt:303); it stands again only if that instruction is void
verified_how: Fetched https://www.buzer.de/gesetz/11778/al211464-0.htm (buzer's comparison page 'Änderung § 12 SAZV vom 01.01.2025', a.F. beside n.F.) on 2026-11-02 with curl and the User-Agent 'legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)', after reading https://www.buzer.de/robots.txt (it allows these paths). HTML page sha256 50a287dc4dd5ea2888483efd867e8699bb03bed5bfdb8b12aa61b7ab894c71c0. Converted by a script: the unchanged blocks and the 'Text alte Fassung' column only, in page order, one line per paragraph; buzer's sentence numbers, its labels and its highlighting were dropped and its heading replaced by line 1. The Federal Law Gazette text of the 2015 Regulation (BGBl. I S. 1995) was NOT read. Every word of this file is also determined by gazette texts deposited beside it: Art. 5 No. 4 of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 inserts a comma and 'soweit nicht zwingende dienstliche Gründe entgegenstehen' after 'auszugleichen' in § 12(1) sentence 2 (bgbl-2025-i-78.txt:161-162), and this file's paragraph (1) is the current paragraph (sazv-12.txt:2) without them; paragraph (2) is word for word the current text; the only other change since 2015, Art. 2 No. 5 of BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34 (bgbl-2022-i-34-flow.txt:225-226), replaced 'gleitender Arbeitszeit' with 'Gleitzeit' in sentence 4, which reads 'Gleitzeit' here. buzer dates this version 'vor dem 01.01.2025'.
notes: An aid, not the law: buzer.de is a private consolidation; here it only confirms what the gazette instructions already determine. German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss. Deposited for the encoding legalese-opus-5.5 (the reading on which BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 Art. 5 No. 4 is void).
